contexts.text: Enthusiastic Spirits are similar (to these visionary ones), but have visions about the things to be believed, by which they are so strongly persuaded, and persuade others, that they are able to swear that what is false is true, and that what is fallacious is real... They have contracted this from persuasions and principles of falsity while they lived.
Doctrinal things of every kind can be confirmed... as theirs by enthusiasts...

Such persons are visionaries and enthusiasts, and whatever Spirit they hear they believe to be the Holy Spirit, when yet they are enthusiastic Spirits... Enthusiastic Spirits are distinguished from other Spirits by this, that they believe themselves to be the Holy Spirit, and that the things which they say are Divine. These Spirits do not injure man, because he honours them with Divine worship...
See Quaker. SE 423:end. SE 3781. SE 3815. LJPost 59.
They come into a like enthusiasm after death.
Diabolical visions... induced by enthusiastic and visionary Spirits...
They who are instructed by influx what to believe or what to do, are not instructed by the Lord, nor by any Angel of Heaven, but by some enthusiastic Spirit, and are led astray.
After death, most enthusiasts fall into the insane phantasy that they are the Holy Spirit. AE 1182:5.
A similar and still more ardent zeal exists with enthusiasts.
(Spurious charity)... can be joined to... the faith of enthusiasts...
Every man who is sensibly acted upon by any Spirit... thinks that it is the Holy Spirit; all enthusiasts suppose this. SE 2940:end. SE 3011.
They judge concerning them as if they were enthusiasts. SE 1987.
Whether they will call it enthusiasm...
Almost the whole World of Spirits is wicked, and enthusiastic, and is sedulously desirous to obsess man...
With enthusiasts there are enthusiastic Spirits. AE 1182:4. LJPost 49. DeVerbo 13:2.
A place where there were enthusiastic Spirits.
From (the Hells of the Ancient Church) have chiefly come forth the enthusiasms in the Christian world.
